vc_sentences: T2R1-020 (row 58): System Mapping L58, Example Analysis C18/D18, Population Rules C9/D4 and Sample File A76/A77 corrected to the sum of campo 45 'IBC CCF' per AT2 v30 §2.1.1.1 campo 20; M58 unchanged; the cross-reference in M112 (T2R2-095) kept consistent.

T2R2-045 / T2R2-065 (rows 111, 138): the 25-SMMLV ceiling removed from the IBC CCF in M111, M138, Payroll Scope Summary C28 and Population Rules C4/D20; the base is the monthly salary payroll (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17), 70% for an integral salary (Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49); floor rules unchanged.

T2R2-076 / T2R2-043 (rows 150, 109) and Population Rules C7: the ET art. 114-1 exoneration test restated as total earnings of the month (total devengado) below 10 SMMLV (Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7), plus N whenever campo 43 is at or above 10 SMMLV (AT2 v30 campo 76).
A1-001 / T2R1-004 (rows 4, 42): source of the employer name stated (registered legal name held in company configuration, not the HR Blizz 'Organization' label with the company-code prefix).
A1-029 (row 32): derivation of AAAA-MM from the start date of the payroll period added; the N/A field type remains an open RA query.
T2R1-019 (row 57): count the Record Tipo 2 lines written; PMI headcount 261 includes 20 interns (Employee Group 6, WT 62149) without a contribution base.
T2R2-003 / T2R2-004 (rows 65, 66): PMI derivation of document type and number from the Master Data document columns, and the join on document type + number, added.
T2R2-005 (row 67): PMI derivation of the contributor type from Employee Group / Subgroup through a client-confirmed mapping table added.
T2R2-009 / T2R2-010 (rows 71, 72): PMI 'Work location' is a city name; a DIVIPOLA mapping table is required; 4 blank values flagged as blocking data errors.
T2R2-023 (row 86): VST trigger defined on salary-constituting variable payments; the wage-type list remains to be confirmed against the annex.
T2R2-027 (row 90): PMI mapping WT 79001 -> X and WT 79018 -> L added; cash-compensated vacation (WT 79003) left open.
T2R2-031 / T2R2-033 (rows 95, 97): PMI holds administrator names, not codes; name-to-code tables from the Ministry catalogue required; blanks flagged.
T2R2-041 (row 107): PMI derivation of X / F from WTs 62140 / 62100 and the 70% rule for the parafiscal base (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49) added.
T2R2-042 (row 108): IBC computation order (70% integral, Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 add-back, floor and ceiling, round up to the peso) and PMI reference values added.
T2R2-044 (row 110): treatment of IGE, LMA and VAC-LR days in the ARL base flagged for RA confirmation.
T2R2-095 (row 112): 70% rule for an integral salary and PMI reference WT 64991 added; wording aligned with decisions 1 and 2.

T2R2-047 / T2R2-055 / T2R2-063 (rows 115, 124, 133): compute base x rate and round up to the next multiple of 100 instead of copying the peso-rounded payroll amounts; PMI wage types for reconciliation listed.
T2R2-048 (row 116): PMI voluntary-fund wage types 25812, 25813, 25814, 25815 and 25823 (FVOL) excluded from this field.
T2R2-051 / T2R2-052 (rows 119, 120): split of the single PMI FSP wage type 2553 into the solidarity and subsistence sub-accounts stated.
T2R2-057 to T2R2-060 (rows 126-129): explanations aligned with the Conditional Reason (blank / zero in every case under AT2 v30); PMI leave wage types not mapped.
T2R2-078 (row 135): PMI per-employee risk class with mixed formats normalised to a single digit 1-5.
T2R2-085 to T2R2-090 (rows 160-165): AAAA-MM-DD format, merge of split incapacity rows, selection of absences by date and exclusion of cash-compensated vacation rows stated.
Example column K: 19 N(9) amount fields (rows 106, 108-112, 115-118, 121, 124, 125, 133, 138, 140, 142, 144, 146) corrected from 12-position to 9-position examples.

Queries to RA added in column T (rows 65, 67, 68, 86, 90, 107, 108, 110, 111, 126-129, 135, 150); Field Explanation of T2R2-006 (row 68) unchanged pending the client's answer on the 'Pensioner Effective Date' (decision 7 of 15 Oct 2026).

Example Analysis D21: the 25-SMMLV ceiling restricted to T2R2-042, T2R2-043 and T2R2-044; T2R2-045 (IBC CCF) has only the floor, on the monthly salary payroll (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17), 70% for an integral salary (Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49).

Population Rules C23: IGE and LMA authorisation numbers and values are no longer reported in T2R2-057 to T2R2-060 (always blank / zero under AT2 v30); the benefit is still modelled as paid and receivable for the reimbursement claim.
